# Textarea
Multi-line text entry with optional character counter.

**When to use** — notes, messages, descriptions, any input that can exceed one line.
**When not to** — single-line values (Input), rich text or code (neither exists — log a candidate).

## Variants
`default` bordered · `filled` on subtle surfaces. Figma also defines `unstyled`; the code does not have it yet (see `state/discrepancies.json`).

## Do
- Set `rows` or `autoGrow` so the field starts at the expected height.
- Show `maxLength` with the counter so the limit is visible before it is hit.
- Use `resize="vertical"` (default) — horizontal resizing breaks layouts.

## Don't
- Don't use a Textarea for a value that must stay on one line.
- Don't hide the counter when a limit is enforced.

```tsx
<Label htmlFor="note">Note</Label>
<Textarea id="note" rows={4} maxLength={280} />
```
